hooks.text: Two days after measuring a bend, the Quebec Bridge fell.
Why did the Quebec Bridge fall after staff measured a bend?
The bridge was doomed, but seventy-five lives could be saved.

title: The Bend Measured Before Quebec Bridge Fell ⚠️
description: Quebec Bridge staff measured an enlarging lower-chord bend before the 1907 collapse. The Royal Commission did not believe action after August 27 could have prevented the fall, but found better judgment might have prevented the loss of life.
